name: ac-fund-structures-and-wrappers
description: The legal wrapper around a portfolio and what it decides: open-end versus closed-end construction, UCITS and the European passport, US registered fund structures and the Investment Company Act limits, unit trusts and SICAVs, exchange-traded versus mutual fund mechanics, business development companies, and the investor-eligibility and distribution rules that follow from each wrapper. It explains what a structure permits and prohibits; it never recommends a fund and never gives legal or tax advice. Use when asking "UCITS", "SICAV", "OEIC", "40 Act fund", "closed-end fund", "NAV discount", "BDC", "fund domicile", "why can't I buy this fund", "ETF versus mutual fund structure". Not for evaluating a fund's cost and tracking (ac-fund-selection), not for evaluating a manager (ac-manager-and-vehicle-diligence), not for private fund financing (ac-portfolio-financing).
